item.title: Faster blob copying in Azure Blob Storage
item.description: I generally try to avoid copying blobs in Azure and just reference a single copy, but there are some situations where you do need to make a copy. The technique you choose can make a big difference to how long that copy takes. For example, the "naive" approach of downloading the source and re-uploading it to the destination is conceptually simple but likely to be very slow. On my laptop, a 10GB copy using this technique took about one hour, but that same copy can be done server side in minutes, and if you use a parallel block copy approach (similar to that used by AzCopy) you can copy a file of this size in seconds.
